project_overview: CCTNS是一个连接公民与警察单位的信息交换系统，旨在提高工作效率并减少文书工作。

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: 公民用户，可以使用系统获取信息或向警方提交请求

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: 管理员，负责系统配置和用户管理

functions.name: CustomizeUI
sub_capabilities: 移动和调整界面元素大小
acceptance_criteria: 用户配置应保存在用户配置文件中
界面应允许最大程度的自定义

functions.name: ConfigureSystem
acceptance_criteria: 配置应反映在系统行为中
管理员应能轻松更新配置

entities.name: UserProfile
entities.description: 用户配置文件，存储用户个性化设置

attributes.name: defaultValues
attributes.description: 数据输入的持久默认值

constraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许数据输入有持久默认值
constraints.source_text: The System must allow persistent defaults for data entry where desirable. These defaults should include: user-definable values; values same as previous item; values derived from context, e.g. date, file reference, user identifier;

constraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集
constraints.source_text: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索
